mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those to be negotiated during collective bargaining while those not negotiable can be discussed by another body - the joint consultative council."
Negotiable matters are those to be negotiated during collective bargaining while those not negotiable can be discussed by another body - the joint consultative council.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of all or a few elected numbers of chief executives."
The committee is made up of all or a few elected numbers of chief executives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the operator of joint ventures."
The Shell Petroleum Development Company Limited is the operator of joint ventures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to actions that conform to the due procedure laid out in the collective agreement."
Constitutional strike refers to actions that conform to the due procedure laid out in the collective agreement.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long process which would have been agreed to with the union either at the time the recognition agreement was being negotiated or separately as a procedural agreement."
Union negotiation is a long process which would have been agreed to with the union either at the time the recognition agreement was being negotiated or separately as a procedural agreement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process often used where management appear autocratic."
Deputation is a process often used where management appear autocratic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt by employers to fix realistic wages."
Realistic wage fixation is an attempt by employers to fix realistic wages.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Nigerian Union of Bank, Insurance and Allied workers, the Consolidated Petroleum, Chemical and General Workers Union of Nigeria, the Nigerian Union of Teachers, etc."
Examples of such unions are the Nigerian Union of Bank, Insurance and Allied workers, the Consolidated Petroleum, Chemical and General Workers Union of Nigeria, the Nigerian Union of Teachers, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined broadly as a discipline concerned with the systematic study of all aspects of the employment relationship."
Industrial relations is defined broadly as a discipline concerned with the systematic study of all aspects of the employment relationship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of furthering basic union purpose which is to maintain and improve working conditions."
Collective bargaining is a method of furthering basic union purpose which is to maintain and improve working conditions.
fib: ______ are those that cover all the employees in an industry or a collection of industries, and are usually strong due to their large membership.
Industrial unions
Industrial unions are those that cover all the employees in an industry or a collection of industries, and are usually strong due to their large membership.
______ is the area in which it draws its membership, and no other union can compete with it for the workers in the particular industry.
industrial union's jurisdiction
An industrial union's jurisdiction is the area in which it draws its membership, and no other union can compete with it for the workers in the particular industry.
______ is the third force in the industrial relations system.
State
The State is the third force in the industrial relations system.
______ is the Yaba College of Technology, Department of Management Studies.
Institute's Cradle
The Institute's Cradle is the Yaba College of Technology, Department of Management Studies.
______ is responsible to the Governing Council through the Management Committee.
Secretariat
The Secretariat is responsible to the Governing Council through the Management Committee.
______ are the main power resource of working people.
Trade unions
Trade unions are the main power resource of working people.
______ can be defined as a temporary cessation of work efforts by employees in the pursuance of a grievance or demand.
strike
A strike can be defined as a temporary cessation of work efforts by employees in the pursuance of a grievance or demand.
______ are the products of collective bargaining.
Collective agreements
Collective agreements are the products of collective bargaining.
______ is the maximisation of economic growth and development for the nation.
ultimate effect
The ultimate effect is the maximisation of economic growth and development for the nation.
